positions.as_written: Read opening in full extension as implicating the posteromedial structures.
Use valgus stress radiography where the grade decides the treatment.
Expect a healed ligament to be functional at a greater length than the original.
Treat valgus laxity as the finding that is easy to measure and easy to over-read in isolation.
Assess rotation, because rotatory laxity implicates the corner.
